texts.preamble: Satya Prakash Gupta vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 5 November, 2020 Bench: Pankaj Naqvi, Vivek Agarwal High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Court No. - 43 Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 11256 of 2020 Petitioner :- Satya Prakash Gupta Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
texts.arguments: The relief sought in this petition is for quashing of the F.I.R, dated 30.08.2020 registered as Case Crime No. 0652 of 2020, under sections 272, 273 IPC P.S. Babupurwa, District Kanpur Nagar. Sri Rakesh Pande, learned Senior counsel submits that on the allegations made in the FIR, offence, if any would be attracted under the Food Safety and Standard (Amendment) Act, 2008, no prosecution for alleged IPC offences can be made out. Learned AGA opposed the submission. The Apex Court in State of Maharashtra & Anr. Versus Sayeed Hassan Sayeed Subhan & Ors. reported in AIR 2018 SC 5348 has settled the controversy that in respect of food adulteration, an accused can be prosecuted both under the IPC offence as well as Food Safety and Standard (Amendment) Act, 2008 as the ingredients of both the offences are different.
